title: Adopt the existing Peak State frame as the baseline
context: The repo already holds the concept frame, prompts, v1 schemas, examples and the On-Aim research page. Coverage rules require every owned file to trace to a decision.
decision: Everything that existed before the hackathon setup is accepted as baseline and owned per coord/lanes.json: README.md, LICENSE, .gitignore, docs/*.md, prompts/, schemas/*.schema.json (v1), examples/. docs/on-aim-closed-loop.html is brought over from the add-on-aim-closed-loop-research branch so every lane can read it. Lanes change these files through their own decisions.
alternatives: Exempt pre-existing files from coverage: leaves a hole that new files could slip through
consequences: Lane decisions that rewrite these files should name this one in dependsOn or supersede it for their paths.
author: claude (coord)
